blocks.text: Months after her pregnancy announcement, Empress Schuck happily shared that is expecting a baby girl, her second child with husband Vino Guingona. Schuck revealed the gender of her baby through an Instagram post featuring photos from their gender reveal celebration. “I can’t believe it! It’s another girl!,” Schuck wrote in the caption. In the photos, Schuck and Guingona were dressed in matching pastel pink outfits, surrounded by pink balloons and flowers.
